title: Five real packing recordings: development study
type: development observations, not a held-out benchmark
scope: One person, one workspace, one reference, five attempts. These recordings informed fixes. They were processed across different builds; expected scenarios were not frozen in the independent trial system. No accuracy percentage is claimed.
remaining_limit: The card covers the cube at the end of otherwise correct attempts. Earlier visible placement does not prove the required final placement remains true.

cases.expected_behavior: Accept if all required evidence is visible
cases.observation: The original result exposed containment and tracking errors. Fresh inference after the fixes verifies the visible placements; the covered final cube still requires review.
